rows.note: Use this for sailing as a sport or organized activity; it is the most precise everyday noun for that slice.

example.traditional: 我每個星期日都去參加帆船運動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 heoi3 caam1 gaa1 faan4 syun4 wan6 dung6

rows.note: Use this for the broader activity of travelling by sea under sail when the wind-powered craft is clear from context.

example.english: We went sailing, and the views along the way were beautiful.
example.traditional: 我哋坐住帆船航海，沿途風景好靚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zo6 zyu6 faan4 syun4 hong4 hoi2 jyun4 tou4 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3
